## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue and the operator-visible result of this change.

## Operational and compatibility impact

List changed flags/exit codes, network traffic, cache writes, privilege needs, restart/data effects, or workflow assumptions. State whether guidance, collector behavior, or both changed.

## Validation and limits

List checks actually run and their results. Include relevant failure-path coverage and distinguish synthetic tests from target integration or restore exercises. Record skipped checks and remaining uncertainty.

## Review

- [ ] Affected prompt, runbooks, templates, and interface documentation agree.
- [ ] Failure and incomplete-coverage states remain explicit.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are synthetic/redacted and contain no secrets.
- [ ] Claims match the available evidence and support policy.
- [ ] Relevant checks from CONTRIBUTING.md passed, or limitations are stated above.
